topic: Moving a SQL application to CockroachDB
title: Moving a SQL application to CockroachDB
brief: Port an application contract and transfer writes from PostgreSQL to CockroachDB with a reconciled return path.
outcomes: Find semantic incompatibilities behind SQL similarity
Validate a consistent copy and a single write authority
entry: Application SQL, schema compatibility, request identity and CockroachDB transactions.

heading.title: The application contract
heading.brief: Inventory types, deferred constraints, sequences, isolation, driver errors, extensions and operational assumptions; test an actual deferred-reference transaction on both pinned engines.

heading.title: A correct target protocol
heading.brief: Replace an unsupported dependency by compatible write order or an explicit protocol; validate constraints, retries and tenant boundaries as runtime roles.

heading.title: A consistent copy
heading.brief: Rehearse an owned write-frozen PostgreSQL snapshot transfer, meaningful data checks and authority handover; label lower-downtime change capture as a separately verified route.

heading.title: Work after cutover
heading.brief: Record target-only purchases, identity and external effects; prove how they would be reconciled before a return rather than declaring rollback from a source snapshot sufficient.
